The whole diagram is a recommended assembly, not an implementation audit.
Grouped Runtime boxes denote existing collaborators, not new facade classes.
Provider registries only route an already resolved Model.
Agent settings fix bindings; each new execution queries its selected model.
Query outside Session locks; revalidate before acceptance.
Tool loops and original-root resumes reuse the execution snapshot.
Mate controls all output limits, including summaries.
[P] relations and marked classes: Pending implementation.
AI emits events; only Runtime writes Session state.
Generic previews and internal diagnostics: implemented in PR 336.
Complete arguments are parsed independently; preview never executes.
模型调用许可（Redis 全局）与 JDK HttpClient：待实现，替换 Reactor Netty。
